Nina Patel: Quick mini-poll — help me pick the next WFH snack pack! React with emoji or reply.

Choices:
• 🍫 dark chocolate :chocolate_bar:
• 🥜 mixed nuts :peanuts:
• 🥭 dried fruit mix :mango:
• 🍪 mini cookies :cookie:
• 🧃 shelf-stable drinks :juice:

I'll close Thurs EOD and order for remote folks + office. :sparkles:

Carlos M.: 🍫 all the way. dark chocolate wins. :raised_hands:

Devon K: 🥭 dried fruit for me. keyboard crumbs are tragedy.

Sophie L: 🍪 tiny cookies make morale go up 100%.

Jen (People Ops): Nina, can we add an allergy-safe option (nut-free)? also open to two-item packs.

Carlos M.: +1 to two items. also veto kale chips forever. :pleading_face:

Devon K: 🥜 nuts + 🍪 cookies = balanced.

ops-bot: Interim reaction tally:
